notes.title: TramSim | Community Update
notes.notes:
Dear community,

we appreciate your passion for TramSim and understand and see the disappointment among some users.

Although, at this time, we cannot confirm any new feature updates or new route content for TramSim, we are actively exploring all options to ensure the best possible experience for our community.

We also want to emphasize that over the years, we have continuously maintained and improved TramSim with many enhancements, new features, and free content beyond the initial release.

Your continued support means a lot to us, and we will keep you informed of any developments in the future.

notes.title: TramSim Vienna Update 1.8 - New Line 71
notes.notes:
As promised, today we have our Christmas present to the community for you: We have been working on improvements and bug fixes again and are happy to present you the third drivable line in Vienna with this update: The line 71, which you can now drive from Börse via the Ringstraße and Schwarzenbergplatz to St. Marx with a realistic timetable and real announcements.

Changelog:
 The Line 71 can now be driven between Börse and St. Marx
 Various performance optimizations
 The type ULF A1/B1 now have the correct Annax matrix displays
 Control of the cameras is now also possible in paused state
 Chinese language is now selectable in the game
 Bugfix: When pressing the key "C" at the E2 the game froze
 Bugfix: The matrix destinations of the vehicle R2.2b for the line U2Z were not displayed
 Bugfix: Some keystrokes were not recognized in Tram-Challenges
 Bugfix: The timetable data for the passenger information displays were displayed incorrectly or not at all at some stops
 Bugfix: The game flickered in VR mode

This update will end the public beta and unlock this new version as default version. If you had the public beta activated, Steam will automatically deactivate the beta selection and the game will be updated to the newest version.

We are still working on performance improvements and fixes for crashes. If you still have problems you can always switch back to the last version 1.5 by selecting "version_1.5" in the branch selection in the beta settings of TramSim Vienna.

We hope you enjoy line 71 and wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
Your TramSim Team

notes.title: TramSim Vienna Update 1.6.2 (Public Beta)
notes.notes:
To get this update you have to switch to the "Public Beta" Branch via Steam!

The long-awaited update for Vienna is now available, which brings dynamic weather (including windshield wiper functions), the wheelchair driver and the R2.2b to Vienna! Also included are performance optimizations and much more, as you can see in the changelog below.

Changelog:
General:

The wheelchair driver already known from Munich has now made it to Vienna and is waiting to be let in and out by you via wheelchair folding ramp
Also in Vienna you can now use the dynamic weather and drive in snowfall, rain or cloudy conditions. Don't forget to turn on the windshield wipers ;)
The vehicle R2.2b is now also available for Vienna, if you own TramSim Munich
Due to the update of the Unreal Engine to version 4.26, the performance in the first public beta update unfortunately dropped noticeably. In the last few weeks, we have been intensively analyzing and fixing performance problems and were able to achieve a significant optimization in various areas, which has led to a noticeable performance improvement (compared to the previous public beta updates).
The number of AI cars, pedestrians, as well as the amount of waiting passengers in stations is now dependent on the time of day
Bugfix: Some Steam achievements could not be unlocked or were not registered as completed
Bugfix: Some joysticks were not recognized during axis configuration
Bugfix: In the tutorial missions the mission names were not displayed correctly
Bugfix: The level-up texture was not displayed correctly
Bugfix: The snowflake effect in the main menu was not displayed correctly or snowflakes sometimes did not fall over the whole screen

Vehicle E2:

AI trams on line U2Z now correctly display "Oper, Karlsplatz U" on the matrix display again (instead of just "Karlsplatz U")
Bugfix: Trams were sometimes running as "Sonderzug" although they were running a route trip


Vehicle ULF:

The engine sound was slightly reworked
Bugfix: On some doors the light textures of the door warning lights were not displayed correctly

Vehicle Flexity:

Bugfix: Starting from the 2nd cab the light textures for the interior lighting as well as the door warning lights were not displayed correctly
Bugfix: In some situations, a closed door was still displayed as open by means of the door indicator light and highlighted in yellow on the left cockpit display

AI trams:

Bugfix: In some places on the map, AI trams got stuck and did not continue to move
Bugfix: AI trams (all vehicle types) now always correctly switch on the interior lighting at night or in the tunnel

We hope you enjoy the new features and changes in Vienna!
Your TramSim Team

notes.title: TramSim Vienna Update 1.6 (Public Beta)
notes.notes:
To receive this public beta update you have to switch to the "Public Beta" branch via Steam!
On some computers, the performance of the game might decrease with this update. If this should be the case for you, simply deactivate the "Public Beta" branch again.

Today is the day, with the new TramSim Vienna - Update we provide you with five new AI lines, real-time passenger information displays, a more realistic behavior of the AI trams, as well as other new features, improvements and also some important problem fixes.


Here is the changelog in detail:

AI Trams:
 The maximum number of AI trams is now adjustable. Since there are more lines and therefore more vehicles on the map with this update, the setting has to be adjusted according to the performance
 Line D (Nußdorf - Absberggasse) was added as an AI line and runs in the game between Börse and Oper, Karlsplatz with the vehicle types ULF B and E2
 Line 2 (Dornbach - Friedrich Engels Platz) was added as an AI line and runs in the game between Parlament and Oper, Karlsplatz as well as Julius-Raab-Platz and Schwedenplatz with the vehicle types ULF B and E2
 Line 6 (Burggasse Stadthalle - Geiereckstraße) was inserted as an AI line and runs in the game between Eichenstraße and Quellenplatz with the vehicle types Flexity, ULF B and E2
 Line 18 (Burggasse Stadthalle - Schlachthausgasse) was added as an AI line and runs in the game between Eichenstraße and Blechturmgasse with the vehicle types ULF B and E2
 Line 71 (Börse - Kaiserebersdorf) has been added as an AI line and runs in the game between Börse and Oper, Karlsplatz with the vehicle types Flexity, ULF B and E2
 The E2 vehicle is now available as an AI vehicle in the game and runs on lines 1, 2, D, 6, 18, 62 and 71
 Line 1 now also operates with the ULF B and E2 vehicle types
 Line 62 now also runs with the E2 vehicle type and now has a denser interval
 If AI trams are standing in front of a signal, they now wait until the signal allows them to run in the desired direction
 Bugfix: When playing for a longer time, less and less trains were approaching on AI lines
 Bugfix: When the player selected a timetable, the AI train with the same round trip was not removed
 Bugfix: AI trains with a high delay, for example after changing the time, were not removed
 Bugfix: AI trains did not wait for the station wait time at the initial stops
 Bugfix: AI trains closed doors in stations despite stop-showing signal

AI cars and pedestrians:
Passengers now choose one or more lines at stops and only board trains with the desired line
 Bugfix: Pedestrians were walking across the map
 Bugfix: In some places cars spawned too close or too far from the player

General:
 The game is now called "TramSim Vienna", so we have changed the colors in the menus accordingly
 New spawn points for both directions of line 1 in front of the stations Knöllgasse, Johann-Strauß-Gasse and Hetzgasse and a new spawn point in front of the stop Oper, Karlsplatz in direction of Stefan-Fadinger-Platz were inserted
 All new as well as existing spawn points have been sorted by driving direction
 Various improvements for the U-STRAB signal system at the stations Matzleinsdorfer-Platz and Kliebergasse
 The rear destination display of the sidecar C5 has been positioned more visibly
 Some intersections in the game now have more realistic traffic light phases. This makes it easier to keep to the timetable.
 GPU performance optimizations have been made
 New keymapping system integrated: Key mappings can be set individually for different vehicle types
 The switches have been reworked to simulate a more realistic behavior when following other trams
 Covid 19 pictograms have been added to the doors of the ULF A and ULF B vehicles
 The Flexity now has colorful holding loops
 At the doors of the E2 the sticker "Pull hard in case of emergency" (in German) was added
 The passenger information displays have been enhanced and now show complete real-time information about the courses in the area
 Bugfix: The line U2Z was displayed with a smaller font on the passenger information displays
 Bugfix: E2 no longer triggers emergency braking when the joystick emergency brake button is turned off
 Bugfix: When configuring a joystick manually, the emergency brake button setting was reset again and again
 Bugfix: In some places double TSP were given for punctuality
 Bugfix: The gameplay tutorial wasn't playable

We wish you a lot of fun with the new update and all the changes!
Your TramSim Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629292/132f21ed34cdf3fcd0c2968fc1610475180e8160.png

notes.title: TramSim | Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Long awaited and as already announced, another TramSim update is released today, which brings numerous performance optimizations, but also offers new features and improvements, especially for the VR mode. In addition, the update also contains a lot of bug fixes.

Here is the changelog in detail:

Various performance optimizations:
Performance optimization for distant AI pedestrians/passengers
Performance optimization for distant AI cars
Performance optimization for distant AI trams
Performance optimization for parked cars (loading and unloading)
Performance improvement for low performance resp. performance collapse in Knöllgasse
Performance improvement when trams are not moving
Automatic garbage collection is now preferentially executed when the player tram is not moving
Memory consumption after long game time slightly reduced

VR:
The driver camera view can now also be centered under VR using the "space bar"
Bugfix: initial VR view in the cockpit was wrongly rotated and set at a wrong position
VR controllers can now be used as virtual hands to operate buttons, switches/levers and the IBIS and MMIs
When using an Oculus VR headset, the joystick of the left controller can now be used to accelerate/decelerate and the controller buttons "X" and "Y" can be used to control the door release

General:
Zooming via mouse wheel is now also possible in first-person perspective (if you are not sitting at the driver's seat)
Bugfix: sometimes passengers did not enter the tram although the door was open and thus passengers blocked the door
Bugfix: AI cars sometimes drove off their defined paths at low performance
Bugfix: sometimes there were wrong distances between tram cabs or wrongly turned tram cabs
AI humans now despawn when blocking cars or AI trams (so no more stuck cars or trams when blocked by humans)
USTRAB intersection signal logic revised: AI trams now wait for clearance at red signals; clearance is now only given when no train is in the turnout area; clearance is given in order of arriving trams
AI trams now use the turn indicator when they turn or where it is necessary for traffic reasons
Bugfix: AI trams stopped in stations and in front of signals sometimes too early or too late or not at all. In addition, in a few cases AI trams moved very slowly in stations or did not continue at all
AI cars now also got a wheel sound
In the graphics options the display of the dirt (on the outside) of trams can now be switched on/off
Bugfix: new keyboard, gamepad and joystick axis assignments can be saved correctly again
Bugfix: when configuring a joystick manually, the setting of the emergency brake point was reset again and again
IBIS: instead of the line "50", "U2Z" is now displayed correctly
Bugfix for scenario "Switch malfunction": resolved switch malfunction is recognized correctly again
Bugfix: sometimes AI trams with empty matrix destination display were running in the area Schwedenplatz/Hintere Zollamtsstraße in the direction of Prater
U2Z matrix destinations updated and "ViewApp" and "TramSim" matrix destinations added
IBIS bugfix: when starting on line "U2Z", "10142" was displayed instead of "15042" for line/course

Flexity:
The sunblind in the cockpit can now be moved
At the middle MMI screen, the left camera image can now be reactivated for a short time by clicking on the camera area
The center MMI screen now shows the tunnel icon when the vehicle is in the tunnel area
Bugfix: AI trams sometimes did not activate door release in stations

ULF:
Bugfix: exiting passengers always despawned
Bugfix: when colliding with ULF type B AI trams, they were not removed, which resulted in the collision message still being displayed
When the bell button is pressed very briefly the bell sound is now much shorter than before
Bugfix: on AI trams in the distance, the red flashing of closing doors was much too visible
The small light on the roof now lights up together with the normal headlights
AI trams now always have the passenger cabin lights on
Bugfix: ULF driver's door sound kept playing when closing and opening immediately
The switch "Scheibenheizung" (window heater) can now be operated and lets the indicator "Scheibenheizung EIN" (window heater ON) light up

E2:
The front and side sunblind in the cockpit can now be moved
Bugfix: E2 sometimes opened the first door when COVID mode was activated, although it was locked for passengers
Bugfix: emergency braking is no longer triggered when the joystick emergency brake is switched off ("gameplay" menu)
Pressing the "emergency stop" button now triggers emergency braking
The trailer parking brake is now applied when the BAWS is not in "V" position
The spring-loaded lever now springs back from "half" to the "zero" position
The "Schwenkstufe frei" button is now lit (as long as the tram is on)

Depot:
Bugfix: when shunting at the depot onto tracks 4 to 6 of hall 1, there was a brief standstill or incorrect spacing between cabs or cabs turned the wrong way round
Bugfix: the switch at the depot, which leads to the stub track, could be operated which was not intended
Bugfix: the pantographs of the trams parked at the depot are now correctly connected to the overhead wires
AI trams now despawn before they enter the depot area and do not block the player's shunting anymore
Bugfix: on trips to the depot coming from Prater the announcements were not continued after the station Knöllgasse or were shifted by one station
Bugfix: if you were at the depot a second time, you were sometimes directed to an occupied track while shunting
Bugfix: after washing at the depot the positions of the parked trams changed
Bugfix: when switches were set automatically by the shunting operator, the clickspot was sometimes on the wrong side when the switch was set manually with the switch operation rod afterwards
Improvement of the distance detection between AI vehicles and trams in the area between Knöllgase and depot
For parked ULFs there is no buzzing sound anymore
The hall gate at hall 4, track 1 has now got a collision for the player tram

Map:
When AI trams have a different direction request at switches, they now wait until the switch is free and don't just continue driving
More AI cars are now driving in the direction of Stefan-Fadinger-Platz in the area in front of the Opera on the Ring again
In the Karlsplatz/Opera area, the traffic light phases have now been set more optimally
Bugfix: trams in front have already unlocked switches, although the following tram was already in the switch area
Bugfix: AI cars turning over tracks sometimes stopped abruptly and then despawned
Error in traffic light phases at crossing Franz-Josefs-Kai#Julius-Raab-Platz corrected
Stop point for AI cars at intersection Wiedner Hauptstraße#Floragasse adjusted in outbound direction, so that blocking of AI trams by AI cars is avoided
The sound for the background noise outside the tram was revised

We wish you a lot of fun with the new update and all the changes!
Your TramSim Team

notes.title: TramSim | Patch 1.4.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629292/55988c497bfc8b02c88172087331669ca85723ad.png
This update contains the new route U2Z! Also, there are again some changes and bugfixes.

Changelog:
NEW: Route U2Z!
The new route runs between Oper, Karlsplatz and Schottenring and is operated in TramSim with ULF* and Flexity AI trams
The new route U2Z is available for selection in the main menu as well as in the timetable window
Due to the partial closure of the U2 route, some stops are no longer available for transfer - the stop announcements have been adjusted accordingly.
All stops of the U2Z route have received appropriate signs for the new route, also the departures of the U2Z route can be seen on the displays of the dynamic passenger information system
In ITCS/IBIS, the route "U2Z" can be entered with the route code ("Linie/Kurs") "150xx" and the corresponding matrix terminus displays can be selected via "Ziel"
* ULF AI trams require the paid DLC "Type ULF"

Other changes:
Bugfix: AI trams turned wrong at switches
E2 now also gets dirty on the outside and can be washed at the depot
Bugfix shunting: when holding down the brake-release-button, the trams often stopped by themselves
Bugfix: it was not possible to enter the ULF at door 1 during shunting at some places at the depot
Bugfix: in the scenario "Shunting" the rear ULF car parts were always extremely dirty
Bugfix: in the scenario "Shunting" the player was always assigned to hall 2, track 7 after washing, even if the track was occupied
Bugfix: sun blind animation very jumpy when operated with mouse
Various IBIS bugfixes concerning the "Abfahrt!" message
Bugfix: there was no switch noise audible when driving onto switches while shunting
Improved the animation transition of the front brushes at the tram wash when switching on/off
Bugfix: parked ULFs looked much dirtier in a short distance than close by
Bugfix: pause (using "P") did not work in scenarios
Bugfix: Tram-Challenges were not playable anymore, because it was not possible to continue at the intro
Bugfix: on some tracks at the depot you suddenly came to a standstill and heard the crash sound, although no obstacle was visible
Bugfix: at non-faulty switches you also got TSP for fixing the switch fault (= operating twice)
Scenario shunting: now you don't have to start-up the vehicle completely (e.g. direction lever can stay at 0) to finish the task
Shunting scenario: Cars should now run into the trams less often when shunting from Erlachgasse
Bugfix: when re-selecting a timetable trip via the corresponding in-game menu, the IBIS displayed "Keine Fahrt"
Bugfix: E2 tachometer lighting did not work anymore
Traffic light phases at crossing Quellenstraße#Knöllgasse corrected
Free movement area at the depot enlarged a bit more


We wish you lots of fun with the new route!
Your TramSim-Team

notes.title: TramSim | Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629292/3b3a121b38da4621e703b57316f9aee14912577c.png
The current update contains some bug fixes, but also important changes for the correct functioning of vehicle functions for the depot DLC.

Changelog:
The shunting console has been implemented on all three trams (on the E2 currently only in the c5 trailer) and can be used with activated depot DLC. Control either by mouse or by keyboard (default key assignment: Q: speed step higher, Y: speed step lower, X: detent B2 (= hazard braking), Num 5: release brake).
Switches in the Knöllgasse to the depot can now be operated (via ITCS/IBIS or manually using the switch operation rod) with activated depot DLC 
ULF and Flexity now have dynamic dirt on the outside of the vehicle and can be washed in the washing facility at the depot with activated depot DLC. Dynamic dirt for E2 and trailer will be added later
Added switch faults and signal faults (with adjustable frequency level in the main menu) that occur randomly when the depot DLC is activated
Destinations for trips from the depot to Stefan-Fadinger-Platz and Prater as well as destinations for trips from Stefan-Fadinger-Platz and Prater to the depot are now selectable in ITCS/IBIS
All trams: the ITCS/IBIS now switches correctly to the return route for a short trip to Karlsplatz
For Flexity and ULF it is now possible to drive on "VB" (depot drive), or if the shunting console has been activated, with first and last door open. Also the first door can now be opened on "VB" (depot drive) and the last door can be opened during shunting.
For E2 and the c5 trailer, the first and last door can now be opened by means of a key switch on the outside (click on the cover)
Flexity: the speed preselection now decelerates the train if you get too fast due to a gradient and exceed the set speed (provided you do not brake yourself)

notes.title: Free vehicle / update for all TramSim owners!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629292/611410ab3f5f5da944e32aab4bab3b9957193d5d.jpg

The time has come! With the free TramSim update 1.1 you finally have the possibility to drive and operate the E2 yourself! As with the Flexity, the challenge is to stop precisely at the stops (with the E2 by means of 7 braking levels), to perform the passenger change by means of door release and to be accident-free on the road - oh well, the timetable should of course also be adhered to :)
We wish you much fun with the update! The detailed changelog can be found at the end of this posting.

Information about steering and operation of the E2 can be found in the menu under "Tutorials & Help" --> "General Help" or by clicking on the question mark icon in the vehicle menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629292/326460f3d4ec351cc76bf440b16f6515841798cd.jpg

TramSim is extended by a new Tram - the classic type E2! It has been embellishing the cityscape of Vienna for over 40 years. A special feature of the vehicle are the fold-out steps. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629292/a05340308ff151843bde014cd0780002171ad53a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629292/4f68b7149568cbd27467a40ac15c40659b0a56ce.jpg

Changelog:

E2 with trailer c5 added as new vehicle
Selection of different vehicle numbers for Flexity and E2 is now possible
Bugfix: game crashed if you had already started a game, switched back to the main menu and then wanted to start a new game
Bugfix: Driver camera head movement effect was sometimes extremely strong (especially with stronger braking)
Reload hitches were reduced
Bugfix for crosswalks (cars sometimes didn't continue although the crosswalk was free)
Bugfix: TSP double when loading saved games
Bugfix: wrong distances on AI trains between car parts/joints
Sitting down (change from first person perspective to driver perspective) is now only possible near to the driver's seat
Operation of keys/buttons/etc. and switches is now only possible when being near it
Memory cleanup is now done every minute (instead of every 5 minutes)
Centering of driver and interior camera perspectives via spacebar (default key assignment) now correctly resets the rotation to the individual default value of each camera perspective
In E2 there are several predefined cockpit perspectives that can be switched through using arrow keys (left and right) (see also further information below).

Map-Updates:

Car stops points at Burgring set back further
Cars no longer disappear into the side lane at Burgring
Tufts of grass at Schottenring removed
Ground markings on the Ring corrected, which colored car tires or feet white

Currently there are already a few known things, which we will fix in an update:

E2 and trailer: small matrix display (used for line number display) currently doesn't work
E2 and trailer: sometimes passengers are preventing doors to close. In this case please press and hold "Freigabe löschen" (revoke door release, Num 6) for at least 5 seconds
The distance between E2 and trailer increases after a while
To be able to use the newly added cockpit camera views in E2 you currently need to reset the keyboard controls to default
AI trams sometimes move very slow in the area of stations
Repaint functionality for E2 is currently not available but will be added with the next update

notes.title: Big Winter Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629292/e671aed28f188c1d50a152c263f298e97e0851f0.png
Winter has finally arrived in TramSim! Today's big update brings you snow and Christmas lights, among other things. Be sure to check it out - we wish you lots of fun! ❄️

Changelog:
Winter and Christmas have been added as additional seasons (besides summer)! In winter, the trees are bare and there is snow on grassy areas, sidewalks and roofs, on the street it has already melted, but was pushed together at the roadsides by snowplough vehicles and passengers/pedestrians are dressed accordingly. For Christmas, the Christmas lights have been hung and besides, the Christkindl Christmas market is held at the Rathausplatz. Also, there are fewer cars and people on the road at Christmas. The selection of the season also affects the position of the sun and sunrise and sunset times
New Christmas special terminus display added
Deformation of Flexity cabs at a switch near Prater fixed
GUI language can now be changed in the gameplay settings
Russian translation was added
Hungarian translation added
Sanding function implemented (without physical effect yet), the yellow button next to hazard flasher button in the cockpit activates sanding and also emergency braking
AI trams now run correctly according to the timetable and also still spawn when you are in the same place for a longer time
TSPs are now saved immediately after being awarded, so the TSPs of a trip will not be lost in case of a crash
Accidents with trams/cars/pedestrians are now counted correctly and displayed in the trip report and profile statistics
Gamepads can now be disabled in the Controls menu
Flexity passenger cabin lighting now switches on and off correctly in the "Auto" position
Releasing the holding brake is now no longer possible if the pantograph is not applied
Turn signal colour in the middle MMI display has been corrected (green = normal flashing, yellow = hazard flashing)
Length of the bell sound adjusted (the bell function is now implemented exactly as in reality)
Flexity tram headlight intensity was adjusted
Passengers have now been given slightly better fitting Covid masks (some even have TramSim masks now)
Female passengers/pedestrians have now also been given a female voice
Added sound for switch operation rod when taking them out of the holder in the cockpit and when putting it back
Door 1 can now be closed immediately by a pushbutton on the seat control panel as in reality (without closing delay)
The animation direction of the switch operation rod when operating the switch has been corrected (was inverted previously)
Flexity holding brake sound was replaced 
Automatic memory cleanup (every two minutes) implemented
Selection of special terminus displays (e.g. "Sonderzug") on ITCS/IBIS now also works with an active timetable
Fixed a display bug with the profile window (which displays the player name, level, TSP in the top right corner of the game). (Did you know that the profile window can be turned off in the pause menu in the HUD settings (speedometer icon in the upper right corner)?)
Collision message can now also be confirmed by pressing "Enter"
The timing of the day/night change was adjusted
Starting on slopes from standstill (e.g. USTRAB exit) works now
Pedestrians/passengers now also have blue and black cell phones
Sounds (indicators, doors, gong) of AI trams are now much quieter


Map updates:
Fixed floating building at Börse
Traffic light phases corrected for turning traffic light at intersection Franz-Josefs-Kai#Vordere Zollamtsstraße
Traffic light phases corrected at intersection Radetzkyplatz
Traffic light phases corrected for announcing signals and approach signals at Schwedenplatz
Traffic light phases corrected at intersection Franz-Josefs-Kai#Dominikanerbastei 
Traffic light phases corrected at intersection Franz-Josefs-Kai#Morzinplatz
Traffic light phases corrected at intersection Burgring#Heldenplatz
Traffic light phases corrected at intersection Universitätsring#Rathausplatz
Traffic light phases corrected at Rathausplatz station
Traffic light phases again corrected at intersection Wiedner Hauptstraße#Schönburgstraße#Klagbaumgasse
Stop line at Wittelsbachstraße station has been moved and is now in the correct position
Textures for illuminated windows (at night) has been improved


We wish you happy holidays and all the best for 2021!
Your TramSim team

Schottenring: catenary guy wire is now connected properly

Fixed mouse lock after finishing a Tram Challenge round
